verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes a dedicated 'OpenAPI Definition (V1)' page with direct JSON and YAML downloads of the full REST API spec, and the file itself is a valid OpenAPI 3.0.1 document covering /v1. The probe's 404s at conventional paths like /openapi.json do not contradict this, because the spec is hosted at a documented docs-assets URL. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of using the spec, and discoverability at standard well-known paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Fivetran publishes a dedicated "OpenAPI Definition (V1)" page with direct JSON and YAML downloads of the full REST API specification
The spec file itself downloads as OpenAPI 3.0.1 (info version "v1"), covering the /v1 REST API.
